chapter: Looking back and the New York years
title: Touring with Redman: ballads, aloof leaders, sleeping on buses
summary: Redman's band toured Florida, Michigan and Ohio playing slow music; bandleaders kept apart and the band slept on the bus.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Let's stick with Redman for the moment. Did you go out of New York City, did you tour with Don?
Mmm-hmm.
Where did you go?
Buster Smith - 171
We went all down in Florida. Clear on down and back. Then back out in Michigan -- Detroit. All over in Ohio.
What was it like working with him?
It was all right. It was all right. Nice. The music was... He played a lot of slow music...
Ballads?

Ballads and stuff like that. He did a lot of that. He didn't play too many exciting arrangements for the public. Benny Carter, he played all of it. He had them beautiful waltzes and things. He featured himself on trumpet and alto too. But it was all right; it was nice. It just didn't last long. When you get back to town there, it was all over with. You wouldn't see him no more until they get another engagement or something. You didn't even know where he stayed. They don't let you know where they stay.
Who? Benny Carter?
No, neither one. None of them bandleaders.
Really?
No. They don't let you know what's happening. They've got a valet; he'll come around and tell you what's happening.
So it was very much the officers and the men.
Yeah.
You didn't mix with the band if you were a bandleader.
Buster Smith - 172
No! No, they didn't like that.
can you remember any interesting things that happened while you were on the road with Don? Were there any particular events or stories that...?

No, not too much. No, nothing. I don't know nothing. All we did was just traveling around, and sometimes it would be one or two days before we'd get to see a bed. The jumps were so far apart, you had to get right back in the bus and ride... We wouldn't get to see a bed; sleep on the bus. We'd just be on the bus there, ridin' and playin' cards or something or other. We wasn't sleepy.
Did Don ride on the bus or did he have a car?
He was ridin', oh yeah. Everybody was on the bus.
So Don didn't sleep in a bed either.
No, not until he got there. If we were going to be there a day or two, somethin' or other, they'd rent a room. But he got a room by himself. He didn't have no partner. He had a room by himself.
All the rest of the guys had to team up, did they?
Yeah, if they wanted to.
